description: record phase-level outcome and next-phase handoff in an existing Work Manifest without rewriting the whole document. Returns a queued job receipt; retrieve its exact job_id with job_service.get_job for the complete original operation result or typed error.
embedding_description: Record phase state in work manifest. Update a single manifest phase with outcomes, approved decisions, approved artifacts, or handoff instructions for the next phase. Narrow mutation that preserves the rest of the document.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Recording execution state for a manifest phase. record_work_manifest_phase_state accepts {manifest_id, phase_number, status, outcome_summary, approved_artifacts?, next_phase_instruction?}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema. NotFoundError: manifest with this ID does not exist.
